This change changes them to GPIO_INT_HIGH. CHROMIUM: ata: Prevent FS corruption on samus at reboot On Samus, even when rebooting, the root device is power cycled. Normally, during reboot, root device is not power cycled, so the device does not have to flush its volatle drive cache to permanent media. However, in case of Samus, given the SSD is power cycled, we force the SSD to flush its cache by issuing a SCSI START_STOP command, translated into an ATA STANDBY command. CHROMIUM: PM / OPP: Don't double free OPP when adjusting OPP voltage Commit 8f98414c249e ("BACKPORT: FROMLIST: PM / OPP: Support adjusting OPP voltages at runtime") did not quite match the FROMLIST patch it was supposed to be cherry-picking. In fact, it contained a subtle bug that leads to memory corruption in low memory situations. _opp_remove() already does call_srcu(..., _kfree_opp_rcu), so, the explicit call_srcu(..., _kfree_opp_rcu) in dev_pm_opp_adjust_voltage() causes a double free of the old opp. Let's match the version of this patch on the mailing list [0], that uses list_replace_rcu(&opp->node, &new_opp->node); instead of _opp_remove() & _opp_add().
